mapper.select: WITH target_user AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN 1 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN 2 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN 3 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birth_date, CURDATE()) >= 35 THEN 4 END AS age_group, CASE WHEN monthly_income < 3000000 THEN 1 WHEN monthly_income < 4000000 THEN 2 WHEN monthly_income < 5000000 THEN 3 WHEN monthly_income >= 5000000 THEN 4 END AS income_group FROM miraero_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} ), peer_users AS ( SELECT peer.user_id FROM miraero_user peer CROSS JOIN target_user target WHERE CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, peer.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 20 AND 24 THEN 1 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, peer.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 25 AND 29 THEN 2 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, peer.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 30 AND 34 THEN 3 WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, peer.birth_date, CURDATE()) >= 35 THEN 4 END = target.age_group AND CASE WHEN peer.monthly_income < 3000000 THEN 1 WHEN peer.monthly_income < 4000000 THEN 2 WHEN peer.monthly_income < 5000000 THEN 3 WHEN peer.monthly_income >= 5000000 THEN 4 END = target.income_group ), peer_category_expenses AS ( SELECT peer.user_id, category.expense_category_id AS category_id, COALESCE(SUM(transaction_data.amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM peer_users peer CROSS JOIN expense_category category LEFT JOIN `transaction` transaction_data ON transaction_data.user_id = peer.user_id AND transaction_data.expense_category_id = category.expense_category_id AND transaction_data.transaction_type = 'PAYMENT' AND transaction_data.transacted_at >= #{startDateTime} AND transaction_data.transacted_at < #{endDateTime} GROUP BY peer.user_id, category.expense_category_id ) SELECT category.expense_category_id AS categoryId, category.category_name AS categoryName, COALESCE(CAST(FLOOR(AVG(peer_category_expenses.total_amount)) AS SIGNED), 0) AS peerAverageAmount FROM expense_category category LEFT JOIN peer_category_expenses ON peer_category_expenses.category_id = category.expense_category_id GROUP BY category.expense_category_id, category.category_name ORDER BY category.expense_category_id ASC
